Title: Landing light
Requirement text: The drone shall show a light visible from 50 m when it lands or takes off, by day and by night.
Rationale: People near the drop point need to see the drone coming.

Title: Abort switch
Requirement text: The pilot shall be able to abort a delivery and send the drone home at any moment of the flight.

Title: Parcel temperature
Requirement text:
The parcel compartment shall stay between 2 °C and 30 °C during a 20 minute flight,
whatever the weather.
Rationale: Medicine deliveries need a cool box.

Title: Flight endurance
Requirement text: The drone shall fly for at least 25 minutes.
